title: Fem 2d and Fem 3d Structural Analysis Apps
description: Implement two new full-blown Rust apps `fem/2d` and `fem/3d` for finite element structural analysis (displacements, reactions, N/V/M diagrams, stress contours, modal, buckling), plus the greenfield math/solver/meshing kernels they require: `mathematical/sparse` (sparse LDLT, PCG, subspace-iteration eigensolver), RCM ordering in `mathematical/graph`, dense f64 extensions to `mathematical/algebra`, `kernel/2d/mesh` (constrained Delaunay via spade), `kernel/3d/volume` (hex/extrusion/tet-split volumetric meshing), `fem/core` (element trait, formulation toolkit, assembly pipeline, analyses), full 2D/3D element libraries in `fem_2d`/`fem_3d`, and `fem-plugin` (two playground apps, ports 6085/6086, mirroring the `procedural` app template with DocumentApp/ops/undo). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/create-new-fullblown-apps-staged-breeze.md. Phased delivery: v0 2D frame/truss linear static, v1 2D continuum + meshing + contours, v2 3D + modal + buckling. Includes workspace wiring (Cargo.toml members, package.json dev scripts, launch.json entries, plugin registry), verification against analytical benchmarks (patch tests, Cook's membrane, Euler buckling, etc.), and identified renderer gaps (Canvas2d triangles layer, World3d clipping/animation/labels) as a follow-up workstream.
summary:
Delivered the full "feature-complete" FEM engine + UI requested as a continuation of v0, per the user's directive to build one headless calculation library and one UI. Verified 169 tests passing across the whole stack (24 mathematical_algebra + 77 fem_core + 29 fem_2d + 23 fem_3d + 16 fem-plugin), zero failures, plus an independently-confirmed wasm32-wasip2 release build.

**`fem_core` became the single headless calculation library** (no vcs/framework dependency, pure math + `serde`/`thiserror`/`spade`), restructured from one file into modules and extended via 4 parallel workstreams (Wave A) then 2 more (Wave B), each gated on real analytical benchmarks:
- `sparse.rs`: hand-rolled COO/CSR/CscSym sparse storage, a left-looking sparse LDLT direct solver (cross-validated against the existing dense `MatD::lu_solve` oracle — this caught and fixed a real column-orientation bug), Jacobi-preconditioned CG, a dense cyclic-Jacobi eigensolver, and Bathe-style subspace iteration for generalized eigenproblems (validated against both an analytic diagonal case and a dense cross-check), plus RCM bandwidth-reduction ordering.
- `formulation.rs` + `elements2d.rs`/`elements3d.rs`: Gauss quadrature (1D/tri/quad), isoparametric shape functions, B/D matrices, and a full element library — 2D: Bar2, BeamEb2 (now with member-UDL support in 3D's Frame3 too), Tri3Cst, Tri6Lst, Quad4, Quad8, PlateDkt (Batoz DKT, debugged against a reference implementation after two real transcription bugs were found); 3D: Bar3, Frame3, Tet4, Hex8, ShellFacet3 (CST membrane + DKT bending + drilling stabilization). Every continuum/plate/shell element passes a patch test (exact constant-stress reproduction) and a rigid-body test.
- `mesh.rs`: 2D constrained Delaunay triangulation with holes via `spade` (wrapped behind first-party newtypes, never leaking), Ruppert refinement, structured quad grids, Tri3→Tri6 quadratic promotion with edge welding, 3D wedge/hex extrusion, and parity-consistent tet splitting.
- `analyses.rs`: multi-case sparse linear-static solving (one shared LDLT factorization, multi-RHS across all cases), self-weight (derived elegantly from each element's own consistent mass matrix × gravity — no separate density plumbing needed), linear combinations (superposed from solved cases, no re-solve), modal analysis (frequencies matched to the classical cantilever formula within 10% on a coarse mesh), and linear buckling (Euler column load matched within 10%). `mass()`/`geometric_stiffness()` were added to the line/frame elements to support this.

**Document crates (`fem_2d`/`fem_3d`) — the UI-adapter layer**: `Fem2dDocument` gained meshed continuum `regions` (polygon + holes, auto-triangulated into `Tri3Cst` elements, boundary points matched to existing user nodes so supports/loads can target them), `Area` pressure loads, materials gained `nu`/`rho`, load cases gained `self_weight`, and both documents gained `combinations` and `analysis` settings — all with full VCS ops and true inverses following the existing pattern. New `fem2d_solve_all`/`fem3d_solve_all` (multi-case+combination) and `fem2d_modal`/`fem2d_buckling` (+3D equivalents) bridge entry points were added; the original frozen `fem2d_solve`/`fem3d_solve` signatures are untouched.

**`fem-plugin` — the single UI**: model window now shows mesh-edge previews for regions; results window gained a `setResultDisplay` view action selecting case/combination/modal-mode/buckling-mode, a per-element banded (8-band) von Mises stress contour with legend for meshed regions, and mode-shape/buckling-shape deformed overlays for both 2D and 3D (with a frequency/load-factor caption in 2D; 3D has no scene-text field, noted as a minor limitation). Static-result rendering now uses the case/combination-aware `_solve_all` entry points.

3D continuum/solid regions were explicitly scoped OUT of this pass (2D got them since 2D meshing is simpler) — noted as future work under the same goal, along with: nodal-averaged (cross-element) stress smoothing for contours (current contours are honest per-element-Gauss-average flat fills, not smoothed), 3D mode-shape text captions, and richer click-to-place UI interaction (current interaction remains action/form-based from v0, not gesture-based).

Registry regenerated cleanly (32 plugin crates, 34 playgrounds, fem2d/fem3d present at ports 6086/6186 and 6087/6187). Live browser dev-preview verification was not re-run this pass (v0 already established the boot path works once the environment's concurrent-session churn settles) — the 169-test unit suite plus the independently-verified wasm32-wasip2 release build are the correctness gate for this pass.
